description: Estimate dew point using a Magnus formula and flag potential condensation risk when dew_point >= configurable threshold (default 20°C).

result_summary.name: dew_point_c_stats
result_summary.description: Summary statistics of computed dew point in °C.

result_summary.name: condensation_risk_threshold_c
result_summary.description: Threshold used for flagging condensation risk (dew_point >= threshold).

result_summary.name: condensation_risk_counts
result_summary.description: Number and percentage of samples exceeding the dew point threshold.

result_summary.name: first_last_risk_timestamps
result_summary.description: First and last timestamps where condensation risk was flagged (if any).

result_summary.name: risk_periods
result_summary.description: Contiguous periods where dew point was at or above the threshold.

result_summary.name: data_quality_summary
result_summary.description: Counts of out-of-range values and dropped missing rows based on metadata ranges.

result_summary.name: time_range

result_summary.name: last_observation
result_summary.description: Values from the most recent record including computed dew point and risk flag.
